name: DJ Roadkill
source:
Under the moniker "DJ Roadkill," this wacky, fun-loving masked musician is here to make a change in Limbo.

Being the type to never shy away from danger, DJ Roadkill is going to need help in bringing a better future for Limbo and making sure they stay alive in doing so.
